sentences.text:
This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report (FIR) in Crime No.112 of 2009 registered with Akot Fait Police Station, District Akola, for the offence punishable under Sections 409, 420, 468, 471 and 120-B read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.

entities.text: Akot Fait Police Station, District Akola
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicants were serving as Sectional Engineer and Executive Engineer in Minor Irrigation Department, Zilla Parishad, Akola.
It is alleged that the applicants have misappropriated sum of Rs.9,18,043/- in relation to construction and repair of Kolhapuri Bandhara at Bhond Shivar.
According to applicants, the report is lodged on the basis of in-house inquiry, which is not properly conducted.
Moreover, it is submitted that prior sanction was necessary, in terms of GR dated 22.12.2006.
It is further submitted that the applicants have already deposited the alleged misappropriated amount.
Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable after four weeks.
